source.method: sparql:SELECT ?item ?itemLabel ?article ?sitelinks ?published WHERE { { SELECT ?item ?sitelinks (GROUP_CONCAT(CONCAT(STR(?publishedT), "|", STR(?publishedP)); separator=";") AS ?published) WHERE { ?item wdt:P31 wd:Q131436 ; wikibase:sitelinks ?sitelinks . FILTER(?sitelinks > 10) { ?item p:P577 ?publishedSt . ?publishedSt a wikibase:BestRank ; psv:P577 [ wikibase:timeValue ?publishedT ; wikibase:timePrecision ?publishedP ] . } UNION { ?item p:P571 ?publishedSt . ?publishedSt a wikibase:BestRank ; psv:P571 [ wikibase:timeValue ?publishedT ; wikibase:timePrecision ?publishedP ] . } } GROUP BY ?item ?sitelinks ORDER BY DESC(?sitelinks) LIMIT 200 } hint:Prior hint:runFirst true . OPTIONAL { ?article schema:about ?item ; schema:isPartOf <https://en.wikipedia.org/> . } SERVICE wikibase:label { bd:serviceParam wikibase:language "en". } } ORDER BY DESC(?sitelinks) LIMIT 199
